faqs.question: Ques: What is better, doing a Diploma in Engineering after the 10th and B.Tech/BE after the 12th?
faqs.answer: Ans - Both of the mediums are good but the Diploma holders have benefits while joining B.Tech or BE after. Most of the Subjects of the B.Tech or BE are covered in the diploma course so it would be like a revision of the course thus we can say they have a better base for the course. Another benefit diploma holders have is that they would have a job after the course and can pursue further higher study as part-time or distance learning.

faqs.question: Ques: What online courses can graduates join after Diploma in Mechanical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans - There are many online short-term courses available after a diploma in Engineering which could add an extra skill set along with engineering. The courses are - 3D Modeling and Drafting, MATLAB, Industrial Sketching and Drawing, CAE Analysis, Advance MS Excel, etc.

faqs.question: Ques: How can I use AutoCAD knowledge after a diploma in Mechanical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans - You can do freelancing and get project work in 2D and 3D drafting. You can join short-term courses in CAM and CAE and could be more professional in 3D designing.

faqs.question: Ques: Can I join the Navy after Diploma in engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans -  Yes, You can join the Navy by qualifying for the NDA exam.

faqs.question: Ques: What are the top specializations of Mechanical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans - Biomechanical Engineering, Controls, Design, Energy Science and Technology, Manufacturing, micro-Electromechanical System, NanoEngineering, etc.

faqs.question: Ques: Is a diploma in mechanical engineering good?
faqs.answer: Ans: Yes, Definitely Diploma in Mechanical Engineering is good. All said, it is must that you should definitely have interest in Mechanical engineering

faqs.question: Ques: Is a diploma in mechanical engineering a degree?
faqs.answer: Ans: Degree in Mechanical Engineering. The diploma in Mechanical Engineering course trains students in areas such as- machine design, material science, thermodynamics, kinematics, engineering drawing, physics etc.

faqs.question: Ques: How many subjects are there in the mechanical engineering diploma?
faqs.answer: Ans: The mechanical diploma is divided into six semesters with six to eight subjects in each semester.

faqs.question: Ques: Is a diploma holder an engineer?
faqs.answer: Ans: Diploma holders are not called Engineers because they have not learned about Engineering completely. When they pursue an Engineering course after completion of their three years Diploma course then, they are called Engineers.

faqs.question: Ques: What is the salary after a diploma?
faqs.answer: Ans: The general salary of a diploma holder as a fresher in a company is 1.5 to 2.15 lacs per annum with a post of Diploma Engineer Trainee i.e DET. It depends on the type of company you join and it generally is different in various companies.

faqs.question: What is a Diploma in Civil Engineering?
faqs.answer: The 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering, post 10th grade, imparts practical skills for infrastructure development. It covers planning, designing, and construction of buildings, bridges, and more.

faqs.question: What is the scope of a diploma in civil engineering?
faqs.answer: With broad applications in construction, diploma holders can work as site engineers, construction supervisors, draftsmen, and more, in sectors like real estate, railways, and architecture.

faqs.question: What is the highest salary for a diploma civil engineer?
faqs.answer: Diploma civil engineers can earn between INR 2.5 to 4 LPA initially, with experienced professionals commanding salaries exceeding INR 8 LPA.

faqs.question: What will be the salary of the engineering project manager?
faqs.answer: Engineering project managers in India earn an average salary of INR 19 LPA, with entry-level positions ranging from INR 5 to 10 LPA and experienced managers earning INR 20 LPA or more annually.

faqs.question: How do I apply for admission to a diploma in civil engineering?
faqs.answer: To secure admission, candidates need a minimum 50% in class 10th and must appear for entrance exams like Delhi CET, AP JEE, Punjab PET, or Odisha DET.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of a civil engineering diploma?
faqs.answer: A civil engineering diploma provides hands-on training, practical skills, and affordability compared to degree programs, making it a practical choice for entering the field.

faqs.question: What will be the recruiting areas for a diploma in civil engineering?
faqs.answer: Diplomas in civil engineering find opportunities in real estate, railways, architectural firms, roads, and airports, offering diverse career paths in India.

faqs.question: What are the fees for diplomas in civil engineering in India?
faqs.answer: In government colleges, fees range from INR 2,000 to INR 25,000 per year. Private colleges charge between INR 12,000 and INR 99,000 annually for diplomas in civil engineering.

faqs.question: What can I do after a Diploma in Electrical engineering course?
faqs.answer: After diploma one can opt for the job of supervisory level in various industries. Another option available after the completion of diploma in electrical engineering course is to pursue a degree in engineering and can directly get admission into 2nd year.

faqs.question: Is there any C.E.T to take admission in diploma Electrical engineering?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a CET or entrance exam to get a diploma seat. Admission will be also based on the marks obtained in class 10 in some universities and colleges. The candidates who pass the minimum eligibility criteria can take admission directly into the colleges and universities.

faqs.question: Is a diploma higher than a degree?
faqs.answer: A bachelor's degree is higher than a diploma degree. Diploma degree is higher than class 10 boards and lower than degree. It is a little higher in demand than class 12 pass since it provides employment opportunities to the students.

faqs.question: Who issues a certificate after completion of a diploma in Electrical engineering?
faqs.answer: The respected state board of technical education issues the certificate.

faqs.question: Can I get admission into a diploma Electrical engineering after 10th?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get a diploma after the successful completion of the 10th.

faqs.question: What are the top specializations of Electrical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Some of the top specializations of Electrical Engineering are Semiconductors, Microsystems, Computer Networking, Network Systems, Signal and Image Processing etc.

faqs.question: What is the salary after a diploma?
faqs.answer: The general salary of a diploma holder as a fresher in a company is INR 1,40,000 to 1,70,000 per annum with a post of Diploma Engineer Trainee i.e DET. It completely depends on the type of company you join and it generally is different in various companies.

faqs.question: Is a diploma holder an engineer?
faqs.answer: The diploma holders are not called engineers because they have not learned about engineering completely. When they pursue a course in engineering after the completion of their three years diploma course, they are called engineers.

faqs.question: Who can apply for an Electrical Engineering course?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have passed class 12th examinations with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as main subjects can apply for Electrical Engineering admission.

faqs.answer: ANS. If one is determined to take this as an engineering course then it won't be tough. Diploma in ECE branch teaches the basics of nearly all engineering courses i.e. it covers the topics from Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, IT and CSE. It all depends on the capability and skills.

faqs.answer: Lateral Entry is not there for students who want to take admission in the diploma course.

faqs.question: Is a Diploma and BSc degree equivalent?
faqs.answer: Diploma is also considered as an undergraduate program and one will get equal weightage when compared to any other undergraduate programs.

faqs.question: Is any internship required during the Diploma in computer science and Engineering course?
faqs.answer: No this is not mandatory in case of Diploma programme.

faqs.question: What are the areas where one can go after doing a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering?
faqs.answer: Multinational companies dealing in softwares,coding etc require professionals who have knowledge of computers so that they can provide their services to their clients.

faqs.question: Do BTech Computer Science technicals get the same job profile as that of a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering?
faqs.answer: It depends on the company profile that hires graduates.

faqs.question: Ques: What can I do after my diploma in Electronics Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans: After completion of Diploma in Electronics Engineering, one can start their career as a laundryman, Linen keeper, Laundry Master, Executive housekeeper, Tailor, Launderers, Kitchen maid, Chambermaid, Butler, Babysitter, etc.

faqs.question: Ques: What is the scope of a diploma in Electronics Engineering in India?
faqs.answer: Ans: Diploma in Electronics Engineering has a vast number of opportunities in the Government and Private sectors. Various job opportunities in areas like HP Enterprises, Raana Semiconductors Private Limited, TATA Power Strategic Division, Spiderfocus Solutions, Mentor Graphics etc.

faqs.question: Ques: Can I become an Electronic Engineer after completing a Diploma in Electronics Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans: To become an Electronic Engineer with appropriate knowledge, you may consider doing a respective graduation or master's course.

faqs.question: Ques: Is studying Diploma in Electronics Engineering From a private college good?
faqs.answer: Ans: Yes, it is definitely beneficial to study Diploma in Electronics Engineering from private colleges. There are ample of placements and opportunities with private colleges, meritorious students end up doing really well with scholarships

faqs.question: Ques: Should I opt for government colleges or private colleges for Diploma in Electronics Engineering Courses?
faqs.answer: Ans: It depends on your personal choice. Government colleges have higher return on investments than most private colleges. Both types of colleges have almost equal opportunities for career advancement. Research well and choose colleges you think best suit your interests.

faqs.answer: In comparison to the graduation course, a diploma course is more affordable and offers the same level of similarity in Academy courses.Diploma courses are shorter concerning graduation courses. While a graduation course lasts 2 to 3 years, A diploma course lasts for a duration of 6 to a maximum one year.In a short span of time, a diploma course offers more emphasis on practical expect of the hospitality course.It is often seen that a diploma holder or a graduation holder in Electronics Engineering have almost the same pay.

faqs.question: What is the salary you can expectafter an Electronics Engineering diploma?
faqs.answer: The salary of the hospitality sector isoffering a minimum salary of 2L to maximum 4L. Still the upcoming years expect a boom in the hospitality sector.

faqs.question: What are the career prospects for a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: Diploma holders can work as service engineers, quality control engineers, production engineers, or research and development engineers in the automobile sector, offering promising career opportunities both domestically and internationally.

faqs.question: What are the further study options after a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: After completing the diploma, students can pursue a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automobile Engineering or related fields like Mechanical Engineering or pursue a Ph.D. for research opportunities.

faqs.question: What is the scope of a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: Diploma holders can find employment in various roles such as automobile engineers, technicians, quality engineers, designers, and maintenance engineers. The field offers job security, high salaries, and opportunities for growth and advancement.

faqs.question: What are the skills required for a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: Skills needed include technical expertise in engineering principles and mechanics, problem-solving abilities, proficiency in automotive software and technology, effective communication, project management, and CAD knowledge.

faqs.question: What are the best books for a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: Recommended books include "Automobile Engineering" by Kirpal Singh, RB Gupta, GBS Narang, and VD Bassani. These texts cover various topics essential for automobile engineering students.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for a Diploma in Automobile Engineering?
faqs.answer: Eligibility typically includes passing the 10th or equivalent examination with at least 50% marks in mathematics, science, and English. Some institutes may conduct entrance tests or merit-based admissions.

faqs.question: What do Automobile Engineers do?
faqs.answer: Automobile engineers design, develop, and maintain vehicles, working on aspects like technology optimization, assembly process development, and addressing engineering challenges in vehicle design and functionality.

faqs.question: What are the salary expectations for diploma holders in automobile engineering?
faqs.answer: Salaries range from INR 2.5 to 5 lakhs per annum, varying based on experience, skills, and job roles. Average annual salaries can be around INR 5.90 lakhs, with potential variations.

faqs.question: What locations are favorable for careers in the automobile industry?
faqs.answer: Countries like Japan, South Korea, China, India, USA, and Germany have high demand for automobile engineers. Cities like Bangalore in India and the Midwest in the USA are particularly favorable.

faqs.question: Which diploma is better, mechanical or automobile?
faqs.answer: Automobile engineering offers specialization in the automotive field, providing expertise in areas like vehicle design and technology, making it preferable for those interested specifically in automotive engineering.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a software and an automobile diploma?
faqs.answer: While an Automotive Engineer focuses on vehicle design and mechanics, Automotive Software Engineers concentrate on developing software systems for vehicle functionality, safety features, and user experience.

faqs.question: Ques- Is a diploma in IT a good option after 10th?
faqs.answer: Ans- Yes, it is a good option to pursue a Diploma in IT after 10th as it is considered equivalent to 12th and you can enter the job field and grab a good job after the diploma.

faqs.question: Ques- What is the role of information technology in an organization?
faqs.answer: Ans- Information technology is building networks for the company, creating and administering databases, and helping employees with their technical issues so that the organization works efficiently.

faqs.question: Ques- What course can I opt for after completing a Diploma in IT?
faqs.answer: Ans- You can go for B. TECH in information technology/computer science, though the course is of 4 years the diploma students can complete it in 3 years.

faqs.question: Ques- Is it necessary to be from a maths background to pursue the diploma in IT?
faqs.answer: Ans- Yes, it is necessary to have maths and science as a subject or PCM as a stream in 11th to be eligible for the diploma course.

faqs.question: Ques-What are the type of questions asked by colleges taking admissions through entrances?
faqs.answer: Ans- Generally, the paper is objective and the questions are from basic maths and science till class 10th, most of the colleges take admissions through the merit obtained in class 10th.

faqs.question: Ques- Are IT jobs in demand?
faqs.answer: Ans- IT is a major part of the technology industry and as we enter the start-up era, the demand keeps on increasing. Popular job designations are programmer, data analyst, software and hardware engineer, database administrator support specialist, and many more.

faqs.question: Ques- Is there any age limit to pursue a diploma?
faqs.answer: Ans- No, there is no age limit to pursue a diploma. To pursue the course candidates must have passed class 10th from a recognized board

faqs.question: Ques- What are the skills required for an IT course?
faqs.answer: Ans- Candidates must be tech-savvy and flexible in adopting new technologies and ways of working. Also, the other skills required are Creativity, accuracy, and ability to focus are also essential qualities that the students must have and Candidates must possess good communication skills and the ability to work in a stressful environment.

faqs.question: What is Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: It is a three-year 6 semester diploma level engineering programme that mainly deals with study of chemistry of chemicals used in engineering industries.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to study Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: A student who completed their 10th standard with minimum 45% and also has a good score in mathematics and science can enrol into the course on merit basis.

faqs.question: Is it beneficial to do a Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Diploma in Chemical Engineering is one of the new and uprising branches of the engineering field. It deals with study of chemical waste which is useful for environment protection and is a branch having high scope in the near future.

faqs.question: What are Career Options after Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: A chemical engineering diploma holder can become a process engineer, maintenance engineer, chemical analyst, Process technician etc.,

faqs.question: How long is a Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: It is a three year long course and has two semesters in each year having an internship in the last semester of the course.

faqs.question: What are entrance exams for Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: There are no entrance exams for Diploma level engineering courses and admission is based on merit only.

faqs.question: What is the salary Package after Diploma in Chemical Engineering?
faqs.answer: The package after this course is usually INR1,60,000-INR3,00,000 if joined as a technician. It may increase if the candidate completes an engineering course.

faqs.question: Is Diploma in Chemical Engineering better than BSc Biochemistry?
faqs.answer: Even though both the courses have slight similarities, a bachelors in science is more of a chemical science course whereas the diploma in engineering is more of a physics related course. So, it is totally the student's interest.

faqs.question: Is 45% marks compulsory for admission in diploma in engineering?
faqs.answer: Yes, to enter diploma courses, this percentage is a must.

faqs.question: Can I apply for a Diploma in Chemical Engineering even though I do not have all the eligibility criteria?
faqs.answer: Few Institutions may accept the students who do not meet the criteria too but they may not necessarily be good institutions having fame.

faqs.question: What are the subjects in Diploma in Production Engineering?
faqs.answer: Major topics included in any Production Engineering course are Basic Mathematics, Basic Physics, Theory of machines, Design Thinking, Heat Transfer, Work-study and Ergonomics, Production Planning and Control, Design of machine elements, Industrial Automation and Robotics, Materials and Operations Management, etc.

faqs.question: Which are the top Production Engineers in public as well as private sector companies?
faqs.answer: Production Engineers have been hired by both public as well private sector companies such as NTPC (National Thermal Power Corporation), Satyam Ventures, Hyundai, L & T, ONGC (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation), Mahindra & Mahindra, SAIL (Steel Authority of India Limited), etc.

faqs.question: Is a Diploma in Production Engineering course tough?
faqs.answer: A diploma in Production Engineering can be both; easy or extremely tough depending upon the way one studies and learns things.

faqs.question: Is Diploma in Production Engineering course in demand?
faqs.answer: Yes, Production engineers are in great demand in India especially in manufacturing industries with great job opportunities.

faqs.question: What is the course curriculum for Production Engineering?
faqs.answer: Subjects taught in a Production Engineering course usually depend upon the type of course (Diploma/ BTech/ BSc/ MSc/ MTech Ph.D.) a student is pursuing. However, Courses compulsorily include mathematics, physics, and chemistry of different difficulty levels.

faqs.question: Is Production engineering a good course to pursue graduation?

faqs.question: How many years does it take to study Production Engineering as graduation?

faqs.question: Does Production Engineering have a good career opportunity?
faqs.answer: Production Engineers are in great demand and their job opportunities exist in manufacturing organizations occupied in the development, implementation, and management of new production assembly, processes and handling.

faqs.question: Which is better Computer Science or Production Engineering?
faqs.answer: Both of them are in great demand. Computer Science/ IT (Information Technology) is more about maintaining, installing, and improving operating networks, computer systems, and databases whereas, Production Engineering deals with designing, planning, developing and managing various processes to produce high-quality products.

faqs.question: Is Diploma in Production engineering a good course to study?

faqs.question: Is mining engineering a good career?

faqs.question: What is Mining Engineering?

faqs.question: What is the average initial salary of a Diploma in Mining Engineering?

faqs.answer: Ans: No, most of the polytechnic and engineering institutes provide admission in the diploma course on the basis of the marks obtained by the candidate in his/her 10th standard board examination.

faqs.question: Ques: What is the admission procedure for Diploma in Mechatronics ?
faqs.answer: Ans: Most institutes offering a diploma in Mechatronics usually provide admission in the diploma course on the basis of the marks obtained by the candidate in his/her 10th standard board examination.

faqs.question: Ques: What is the difference between Mechatronics and Mechanical Engineering?
faqs.answer: Ans: A Mechanical engineer usually knows everything related to the pure mechanical aspects of a machinery,equipment or device.On the other hand a mechatronics specialist knows a little bit of everything that involves creating the same system.For example:-In todays world where robots and self driven cars are becoming common ,a mechanical engineer may be better suited to create the engine ,body and other moving parts of the car but to integrate the automation aspect of the car one needs a mechatronics specialist.

faqs.question: Ques: What is the work of a Mechatronics Engineer?
faqs.answer: Ans: Mechatronics engineers are uniquely equipped to work as mechanical engineers with electronics, instrumentation and real time software engineering skills.

faqs.question: Ques: What are the job roles one can take up after obtaining a diploma in Mechatronics Engineering?

faqs.answer: Ans: A degree course is offered by an autonomous college or university, on the other hand a diploma programme is provided by educational institutions and even by some colleges. The other difference is a degree course is completed in 3-4 years. While, a diploma course requires 1-2 years for completion.

faqs.question: Ques: What are the opportunities for further studies after completing a Diploma in Mechatronics?
faqs.answer: Ans: After completing ones Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering one can even pursue a Bachelors degree in Mechatronics Engineering.In most degree colleges certain percentages of seats are reserved for Diploma certificate holders. This entry is known as the lateral entry. Diploma holders with good marks can use lateral entry and get admitted in B.Tech/B.E. Mechatronics Engineering programs 2nd academic year (directly).

faqs.question: What is the Diploma in Architecture Engineering?

faqs.question: What are some major tasks a petroleum engineer performs?
faqs.answer: Some major tasks of a petroleum engineer include designing and building oil extraction mechanisms, total quality management, and cost reduction, regular checks and maintenance of industrial machines, surveying wells and searching for new oil extraction points, etc.

faqs.question: What are the career options after the Diploma in Petroleum Engineering degree?
faqs.answer: The career options a student can avail after Diploma in Petroleum Engineering course are:Field OperatorProject ManagerProcess OperatorProgramme Management ExpertPetroleum Service Technician

faqs.question: What is Reservoir Engineering?
faqs.answer: Reservoir Engineering is all about locating the fuels and its sources through various machines. It is about applying principles and formulas to extract the hydrocarbons at the optimum level and about using advanced technologies to imaging an oil and natural gas reserve point.

faqs.question: What is the scope of the Diploma in Petroleum Engineering Course?
faqs.answer: A diploma in Petroleum Engineering is a course that can provide a good job in India and outside of India. The average fee for Diploma in Petroleum Engineering is INR 15000 per year.

faqs.question: What are the popular specializations related to Diploma in Petroleum Engineering?
faqs.answer: Some of the popular specializations for Diploma are Communication Design, Ophthalmic Medicine & Surgery, Securities Law, International Law, Electrician, etc.
